What exists and what is still a box on paper

agent: Agent (any harness) | kapi watch: one line per event | kapi say, pending, preset | writes plan.html directly | built plan: plan.html | page source: prose + kapi-* presets | every block has a data-kapi-id | built daemon: kapi daemon (Go, one per machine) | event log and cursors per page | page store: ids, revisions, undo | renders presets to HTML + SVG | review disk: ~/.kapi on disk | pages/<id>/events.ndjson | cursors.json, revs/<n>.html | built browser: Browser page | Select toggle, block toolbar | chat panel, status dot | review hub: Private hub | R2 + Worker + Access | auto-save wiring next | planned agent -> plan: edits file plan <-> daemon: reads, writes ops, notices your edits agent <-> daemon: socket browser <-> daemon: HTTP + SSE daemon -> disk: append daemon --> hub: publish

The same kind of diagram flipped top to bottom, with nodes in each tone:

cli: kapi CLI | neutral sock: Unix socket | info store: Page store | success queue: Retry queue | warning dead: Dead letters | danger hub: Hub | accent cli <-> sock: requests sock -> store: ops store -> queue: on failure queue -> dead: after 5 tries store --> hub: publish

Flow, both ways

agent -> page file: writes page file -> daemon: mtime change daemon -> browser: revision event browser -> daemon: op daemon -> page file: applies agent -> page file: writes page file -> daemon: mtime change daemon -> browser: revision event browser -> daemon: op daemon -> page file: applies

Sequence

browser -> daemon: POST /ops daemon -> store: Apply(rev, op) store --> daemon: new rev daemon --> browser: 200 {"rev":N}

Checklist

Copy the session store to the new cluster Compare row counts Flip reads to the new cluster Delete the old handler

Copying first lets us compare row counts before any reads move, so a bad copy never serves traffic.

Details can start open when most readers need them.

Plan

Add the page store with revisions under revs/. Serve the rendered page and block endpoints. Agents editing the file mid-request can race a browser op. Should undo cross an agent edit?
